outcome: recurrence of juvenile-onset recurrent respiratory papillomatosis
cohort: 721 patients with juvenile-onset recurrent respiratory papillomatosis who underwent surgery between 2002 and 2019.
finding: Age at diagnosis younger than 4.5 years, high Derkay anatomical score, and HPV type 11 infection were independent risk factors for recurrence of juvenile-onset recurrent respiratory papillomatosis, while adjuvant therapy with interferon was associated with a reduced risk of recurrence.
